adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~15–16 MAD E-shift from ~612 to ~654 with clear opposing return near 654; U also shows a coherent ~−5 MAD drop and recovery. P1 (612–654) matches this full platform. P2 (616–644) is nested, smaller, and its onset/offset offsets are inconsistent with the observed step magnitudes (e.g., E offset only 0.77 MAD vs observed ~15 MAD). Residuals after subtracting P1’s offset (Hypothesis P1) show flat, noise-level behavior across the interval, confirming P1 as the genuine temporary platform. P2 is spurious and overlapping; no other genuine temporary platforms exist in this interval.
